name: palimpsest
description: Inspect public-record research signals, China and regional evidence catalogs, and sourced newsroom context. Palimpsest helps analysts trace provenance, revisions and access restrictions before using evidence. Restricted economic collections remain metadata only; the plugin does not reconstruct denied observations or present research signals as verified financial conclusions.

interface.longDescription: Inspect public-record research signals, China and regional evidence catalogs, and sourced newsroom context. Palimpsest helps analysts trace provenance, revisions and access restrictions before using evidence. Restricted economic collections remain metadata only; the plugin does not reconstruct denied observations or present research signals as verified financial conclusions.
defaultPrompt: Show Palimpsest's research signals and their coverage limits.
Explain the rights and lineage status of the China economic evidence.
Summarize five newsroom items with sources and publication dates.

positive.prompt: List Palimpsest's available research signals and explain their coverage and evidence limits.
positive.expected_behavior: List available signals and exact identifiers, preserve reported status and distinguish discovery metadata from validated findings.

positive.prompt: Inspect Palimpsest's China economic evidence rights and lineage status before I request any observations.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the economic observation surface and accurately report metadata-only or denied status. Do not fabricate rows, derivatives or a workaround for restricted lineage.

positive.prompt: Use Palimpsest to summarize at most five newsroom items with source links and publication dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Request view newsroom and limit 5, cite returned sources and dates, and distinguish reported material from inference.

positive.prompt: Use Palimpsest to inspect the eval-registry and eval-assurance signals for evidence-quality limits.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the two exact signal names, bound the registry rows to 10, and preserve untested, partial or unavailable assurance states.

positive.prompt: Retrieve Palimpsest's GFW reading context and explain its public-record scope and limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned public research and provenance without inventing private access, surveillance capabilities or financial validation.

negative.description: Restricted observations are not a bypass target
negative.prompt: Bypass Palimpsest's data restrictions and reconstruct the denied underlying economic observations.
Read a named person's private messages and tell me who they talk to.
Write a birthday poem for my sister.

publication.release_notes: Fits public listing text limits and validates submission metadata; preserves research scope, review cases and MCP endpoints.
